spec: libraries-and-monitoring-spec.md section 7.2 (blocked frequencies); decisions BF-1 and BF-2 in rule-decisions-2026-10-18.md
rule: A frequency statement is blocked when its whole typed text contains any of: as needed, as necessary, when appropriate, PRN, if needed, per teacher discretion. Case-insensitive. Hyphens, underscores and runs of whitespace (including line breaks) count as one space before matching. PRN matches as a whole word only.

cases.text: for every written assignment longer than 3 sentences

cases.text: when the student puts head down or says "I need a break"

cases.name: empty text is not blocked here (a missing part is a different error)

cases.text: improvement of the pronoun prnx drill
